operating vehicle and avoiding collisions.

lane departures; accuracy will vary based on weather, speed and road condition. System operation affected by extreme interior heat. Driver
remains responsible for safely operating vehicle and avoiding collisions.

package enrollment, credit card will be immediately billed for 1-year Premium package subscription. If you cancel by day 90, you will be refunded
the Premium package subscription fee. If you do not cancel, your 1-year AcuraLink Premium subscription begins - giving you 15 months for the
price of 12.

request for emergency response services will not occur. Neither Acura nor affiliated service providers can control whether emergency
personnel/first responders will respond to any request for emergency response services or do so in a timely manner.
72 Only available on select, navigation-equipped 2014 and 2015 RLX, TLX and MDX models. Accessing vehicle maps with a smartphone, tablet or PC

74 Assist features are not available on all RLX, TLX and MDX models. Live support and automatic request for emergency response services require a

timely manner.
75 Live, concierge services are not available on all RLX, TLX and MDX models. Live personal assistance requires a Premium Package subscription.
See http://www.acura.com/acuralink/packages.aspx for details.
